messages.subject: Re: Spatial DGMM question
messages.body_plain:
Unfortunately, I've had limited time to work on Cardinal during the academic year. I will look into this more for the next update.

The problem appears to be that the calculation of the likelihood gradient is producing non-finite values.

Can you check the image for the feature where it fails? If it's low-quality, a short term solution may be to subset the data to remove that feature.

-Kylie
